judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner sought the intervention of this Court to compel the Respondents to effect an inter-family transfer in his favour in terms of Section 14 of the Land Reforms Law; Statutory determinations made and published by the Land Reforms Commission provide for good title in terms of Section 18 and 19 of the Land Reforms Law; Legitimate expectation entertained by the Petitioner and his predecessor-in-title. Held – Writs issued with cost of litigation.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
